description: This file contains shell functions related to initialization hooks and mount operations in an embedded Linux environment, specifically for OpenWrt. It manages boot hooks, pivoting root filesystems, and overlay filesystem setup.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_start
methods.description: Begins a splicing hook sequence, setting the PI_HOOK_SPLICE variable.

methods.name: boot_hook_splice_finish
methods.description: Completes the splicing hook sequence, transferring hook functions and cleaning up variables.

methods.name: boot_hook_init
methods.description: Initializes a bootstrap hook list for a specified hook.

methods.name: boot_hook_add
methods.description: Adds a function to a specified boot hook.

methods.name: boot_hook_shift
methods.description: Removes and retrieves the first function from a specified boot hook list.

methods.name: boot_run_hook
methods.description: Executes all functions registered to a specified boot hook.

methods.name: pivot
methods.description: Performs a pivot_root operation after mounting /proc.

methods.name: fopivot
methods.description: Sets up an overlay filesystem and pivots root.

methods.name: ramoverlay
methods.description: Creates a RAM-based overlay filesystem by mounting tmpfs and setting up overlay with pivot.
